comparison.objective: Read an equation and place the resulting number of cubes on a plate, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual repeated pick-and-place plus arithmetic; no fine retained adjustment or force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Five cubes on the grey plate; candidate requires measured mechanical response across two cycles and explicit damage/safety exclusions.
comparison.reason: The only commonality is bimanual manipulation; the tested cognition, mechanism, and outcome differ.
